title: BETA-5.5 Audit State

current_snapshot.author: Supratim Sanyal
current_snapshot.repository_history: main starts at the BETA-5.4 baseline; BETA-5.5 began at commit 3eec8e7

notes: Recovery validation was performed in the rebuilt workspace under D:\Users\vagab\Documents\SOFTWARE-DEV\Don't-Panic-Portfolio-Visualizer.
A repo-local NuGet.Config now clears stale Visual Studio fallback package folders so restore works on this machine.
The temp-workspace publish path now copies repo NuGet.Config into the workspace.

Safe-temp publish now publishes to default project output folders first and then copies results into the final artifact layout, avoiding the net10 custom publish-dir bug seen on the legacy screensaver host.

vm_tooling.guest_caveat: The VM has .NET 10 SDK 10.0.203 in the user profile, but a fresh default guest shell still resolves bare dotnet to the machine-wide 8.0.420 until PATH precedence is changed or a machine-wide install is done.

post_remote_recovery_replay.source_of_truth: Recovered from the surviving chat record after catastrophic local storage loss.
replayed_changes: Retargeted the solution from net8.0-windows / SDK 8.0.420 to net10.0-windows / SDK 10.0.201.
Created PortfolioSaver.Presentation and moved the reusable scene control plus runtime presentation services out of the screensaver host.
Created PortfolioSaver.Settings and moved the shared settings UI, content, services, and view models out of the Config launcher.
Created PortfolioSaver.Desktop as the new primary app host with File/Exit, View/Full Screen, Options/Settings, and Help/About.
Implemented fullscreen toggle plus ESC-to-windowed behavior in the desktop shell.
Kept PortfolioSaver.Config as a thin launcher around the shared Settings window.
Kept PortfolioSaver.Screensaver as a legacy compatibility host wired to the extracted Presentation scene.
Updated publish, installer, and VM staging scripts to understand the new desktop artifact alongside the legacy screensaver artifact.
Updated README and BUILD_AND_DEPLOY to describe the desktop-first Beta 5.5 product model.
Added DesktopShellMigrationTests and updated path-based regression tests for the moved code.

beta55_migration_program.goal: Upgrade to .NET 10 and convert the screensaver product into a desktop app with fullscreen mode while retaining a temporary legacy screensaver compatibility host.
design_decisions: Use a new desktop host project instead of mutating the screensaver executable in place.
Extract the reusable scene/runtime into PortfolioSaver.Presentation.
Extract the reusable settings experience into PortfolioSaver.Settings.
Keep the legacy screensaver host during Beta 5.5 for compatibility while documenting the desktop app as the primary product surface.
beta55_migration_program.known_vm_tooling_note: VM guest has .NET 10 SDK installed in the user profile; bare dotnet in a fresh guest shell still prefers the older machine-wide SDK unless PATH precedence is changed.

acceptance: Host build and tests pass under .NET 10.

phases.name: Extract reusable presentation/runtime layer
acceptance: ScreensaverSceneControl and runtime presentation services live in PortfolioSaver.Presentation.
Legacy screensaver host compiles against the extracted presentation assembly.

phases.name: Create desktop app host
acceptance: Desktop shell hosts the shared scene and provides the required menu structure.
Fullscreen toggle plus ESC exit behavior are implemented.

phases.name: Reuse settings UI inside desktop app
acceptance: PortfolioSaver.Settings contains the shared settings window, content, services, and view models.
Options -> Settings opens the shared settings window.

phases.name: Desktop About/help surface
acceptance: Help -> About is implemented in the desktop shell.
About shows app identity, version, and MIT license statement.

phases.name: Demote legacy screensaver semantics
acceptance: Desktop app is documented as the primary product path.
Legacy screensaver host is preserved only for compatibility.

phases.name: Rework packaging, VM automation, and docs
acceptance: Safe-temp publish outputs desktop, config, and legacy screensaver artifacts.
VM prep/validation scripts know about the desktop artifact.
README, BUILD_AND_DEPLOY, and VM runbook are desktop-first for Beta 5.5.

current_operational_recommendations: Treat PortfolioSaver.Desktop as the primary runtime target for Beta 5.5 work.
Retain the legacy screensaver host only while compatibility still matters.
Use the safe-temp build/publish scripts for repeatable validation rather than ad-hoc repo-path publish commands.
Keep VM validation scripts aligned to the desktop-first artifact layout before starting broader Beta 5.5 UX work.
